supporting_pages.title: "Java runtime environment \_|\_ App Engine standard environment \_|\_ Google\
evidence_snippets: Before you begin Download the latest version of the Google Cloud CLI or update your gcloud CLI to the current version: gcloud components update To deploy using Maven, you will need to add the App Engine Maven Plugin to your pom.xml file: <plugin> <groupId>com.google.cloud.tools</groupId> <artifactId>appengine-maven-plugin</artifactId> <version>2.8.1</version> </plugin> Other options for deploying include using the gcloud app deploy command or the App Engine Gradle plugin .

To deploy a Maven project project as source code, go to your project's top level directory and type: gcloud app deploy pom.xml Build and deploy logs will be streamed, and you can see the detailed logs in the Cloud Build history section in the Google Cloud console .
Deploy Maven source projects to the Java runtime You can deploy your Maven project as source code and have it built and deployed using Google Cloud's buildpacks .
